Chapter 418 - 418 The Professor And Students Meet; Interrogation!

Chapter 418 - 418 The Professor and Students Meet; Interrogation!

418 The Professor and Students Meet; Interrogation!

He tasted the delicacies he made.

Whether it was his body or his mind, Lin Fan was extremely satisfied.

He seemed to be fascinated by his own cooking skills. He chose to cook at home for the entire weekend. He was very content.

…

In the blink of an eye, it was Monday.

Today, Lin Fan drove the Cullinan to Jiangbei University under the warm sunlight.

When Vice-Chancellor Feng Weijian saw Lin Fan, he smiled and said, “Student Lin Fan, wait, no. You should be called Professor Lin now. Actually, I think I should have called you that a long time ago!

“Good morning, Professor Lin!”

“Good morning, Vice-Chancellor Feng,” Lin Fan replied.”

“I don’t think you know where your office is, right?” Feng Weijian continued. “I’ll bring you there.”

“Then I’ll have to trouble you, Vice-Chancellor Feng,” Lin Fan said.

“No trouble, no trouble at all!” Feng Weijian laughed.

The two of them chatted as they walked, and their footsteps were light.

“Professor Lin, what are you going to teach the students?” Feng Weijian asked. “If it involves projects and research, Jiangbei University will do our best to meet your funding requirements.”

Feng Weijian was not lying.

It would be extremely difficult for an ordinary professor to apply for research projects and funding.

However, Lin Fan was different.

Jiangbei University was not afraid of Lin Fan’s application, but they were afraid that he would not apply.

Lin Fan said, “I haven’t decided yet. Let’s bring them to win a few international awards first.”

After all, this was also the reason why he was teaching students.

However, Feng Weijian did not take his words to heart.

Lin Fan had not even thought of what to research, yet he wanted his students to get a few international awards first?

How was this possible?

The two of them chatted as they walked.

Before long, they arrived at an extremely spacious and clean office.

There was a huge mahogany desk and a very soft and comfortable executive chair.

In the middle was an antique coffee table and a branded sofa.

There were a few smaller mahogany tables and chairs near the door.

It did not feel like an office at all but more like a casual teahouse.

It was luxurious and stylish.

“Professor Lin, are you satisfied with this office?” Feng Weijian asked.

“Not bad!” Lin Fan said.

“As long as you’re satisfied!” Feng Weijian said happily.”

At this moment, footsteps sounded from outside the corridor.

They were Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Nie Zhenjiang, Hao Zhiwu, Jiang Chaoqun, and Liu Qianqian.

Feng Weijian saw a few people and asked, “How many of you have come? In the future, all of you will study hard under Professor Lin. If you have any questions, you can ask Professor Lin. If Professor Lin doesn’t have time, you can also ask the assistant professors.”

When everyone heard this, they all looked toward Lin Fan.

The moment Xia Bing and Xia Xue saw Lin Fan, their faces turned red. When their eyes met Lin Fan’s, they hurriedly lowered their heads, wishing they could bury their heads in the ground.

Nie Zhenjiang’s expression was a little complicated.

Hao Zhiwu, Jiang Chaoqun, and Liu Qianqian looked at Lin Fan with shock and admiration.

It was no wonder that they were like this.

Lin Fan had never participated in an interview before, nor had he ever exposed any photos of himself on the internet.

They only heard that he was very young.

However, they never thought that he would be so young.

In fact, he even seemed a little younger than them.

“Well then, get along well with your professor. I’ll be leaving first!” Feng Weijian said.

After saying that, he walked straight into the distance.

Lin Fan cleared his throat and said, “Let’s introduce ourselves.”

“Hello, everyone. My name is Hao Zhiwu. I’m from the School of Biological Engineering at Capital University. I love animals and playing games! Those who have a hobby in this area can look for me anytime.” Hao Zhiwu was the first to introduce himself.

As he spoke, he danced.

Obviously, he was an extrovert.

Soon, he left an impression in everyone’s hearts.

“Hello, everyone. My name is Jiang Chaoqun. I’m from the School of Chemistry at Modu University. Reading,” Jiang Chaoqun said.

He had a rather dull personality and spoke very little.

“Hello, everyone. My name is Liu Qianqian. I’m from the Physics Department of Xia Ke University,” Liu Qianqian said concisely.

“Hello, everyone,” Nie Zhenjiang said. “My name is Nie Zhenjiang. I’m from Huaqing University’s Math Department. I like to play basketball.”

“Hello, everyone… My name is Xia Bing. I’m from Jiangbei University’s Department of Computer Science,” Xia Bing said.

“Hello, everyone… My name is Xia Xue. I’m from Jiangbei University’s Department of Computer Science,” Xia Xue said.

After that, they seemed to have used up all their strength and could not stop panting.

Lin Fan gently patted Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s shoulders with a smile. “Don’t be nervous.”

Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s already blushing faces were like ripe tomatoes at this moment. Then, they nodded hard.

Lin Fan said, “Let’s go in and sit down.”

After the six of them sat down…

Lin Fan said, “Let me talk about my short-term goal. I want you to win a few international awards first.”

When Hao Zhiwu and the others heard this, they looked at each other in dismay.

Was it that easy to get an international award?

Lin Fan did not care much about it and asked, “Hao Zhiwu, what are you best at researching?”

“Bio-pharmaceutics,” Hao Zhiwu said. “More specifically, the kidney! I’ve always thought that the kidney is the source of strength. Only when the kidney is good can the body be good…”

However, Lin Fan did not wait for him to finish and interrupted, “Alright, I got it.”

After saying that, he took out a pen and paper and quickly wrote down a list of problems.

“Try to solve these problems.”

Hao Zhiwu was slightly surprised by Lin Fan’s master-level handwriting. Then, he looked at the problems carefully.

He frowned and pondered.

“Alright, Professor Lin!”

“Jiang Chaoqun, which direction are you best at?” Lin Fan asked.

“Polymolecular coating,” Jiang Chaoqun said.

When he said this, Jiang Chaoqun was actually a little nervous.

That was because Lin Fan’s achievements did not involve the study of polymolecular coating.

It was also because of this that Jiang Chaoqun hesitated to come to Jiangbei University after he was selected.

Lin Fan did not think too much about it. He picked up a pen and paper and wrote down some problems.

“Try to answer these problems,” Lin Fan said.

Jiang Chaoqun looked at the paper and read the problems. Other than surprise, his face was filled with joy.

Lin Fan knew about polymolecular coating!

His choice was not wrong!

“Alright, Professor Lin!” Jiang Chaoqun said.

Lin Fan did not care about what Jiang Chaoqun was thinking. He slowly came in front of Xia Bing and Xia Xue and turned on the laptop in front of them.

Lin Fan’s hands seemed to be flying as they jumped rapidly on the keyboard.

At the same time, countless complicated codes appeared on the computer screen.

A moment later, Lin Fan stopped and said, “Try to break it.”
